stance_basis: suggested tunnel connecting Airport Spur and Lake Freeway as alternative design
summary: Stephan Vleansky suggested putting a tunnel under Mitchell Field connecting the Airport Spur and the Lake Freeway as an alternative design approach. The agency responded that a tunnel section of any length and freeway link is not economically feasible and would not conform to the regional land use-transportation plan. His comment reflects a conditional or alternative-seeking posture rather than outright opposition.
complaint_summary: Vleansky suggested constructing a tunnel under Mitchell Field to connect the Airport Spur with the Lake Freeway as an alternative design.
